segments.ja490:1.1: Appossukko dāni tuvaṃ kapota, vihaṅgama na tava bhojanattho;
segments.ja490:1.3: Khudaṃ [khuddaṃ (syā. ka.), khudhaṃ (sakkata-pākatānurūpaṃ)] pipāsaṃ adhivāsayanto, kasmā bhavaṃposathiko kapota [kapoto (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja490:2.1: Ahaṃ pure giddhigato kapotiyā, asmiṃ padesasmimubho ramāma;
segments.ja490:2.3: Athaggahī sākuṇiko kapotiṃ, akāmako tāya vinā ahosiṃ.
segments.ja490:3.1: Nānābhavā vippayogena tassā, manomayaṃ vedana vedayāmi [vedanaṃ vediyāmi (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja490:3.3: Tasmā ahaṃposathaṃ pālayāmi, rāgo mamaṃ mā punarāgamāsi.
segments.ja490:4.1: Anujjugāmī uragā dujivha [uraga dvijivha (sī.)], dāṭhāvudho ghoravisosi sappa;
segments.ja490:4.3: Khudaṃ pipāsaṃ adhivāsayanto, kasmā bhavaṃposathiko nu dīgha [dīgho (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja490:5.1: Usabho ahū balavā gāmikassa, calakkakū vaṇṇabalūpapanno;
segments.ja490:5.3: So maṃ akkami taṃ kupito aḍaṃsi, dukkhābhituṇṇo maraṇaṃ upāgā [upāgami (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja490:6.1: Tato janā nikkhamitvāna gāmā, kanditvā roditvā [kanditva roditva (sī.)] apakkamiṃsu;
segments.ja490:6.3: Tasmā ahaṃposathaṃ pālayāmi, kodho mamaṃ mā punarāgamāsi.
segments.ja490:7.1: Matāna maṃsāni bahū susāne, manuññarūpaṃ tava bhojane taṃ;
segments.ja490:7.3: Khudaṃ pipāsaṃ adhivāsayanto, kasmā bhavaṃposathiko siṅgāla [sigālo (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja490:8.1: Pavisi [pavissaṃ (sī. pī.), pavissa (syā.)] kucchiṃ mahato gajassa, kuṇape rato hatthimaṃsesu giddho [hatthimaṃse pagiddho (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja490:8.3: Uṇho ca vāto tikhiṇā ca rasmiyo, te sosayuṃ tassa karīsamaggaṃ.
segments.ja490:9.1: Kiso ca paṇḍū ca ahaṃ bhadante, na me ahū nikkhamanāya maggo;
segments.ja490:9.3: Mahā ca megho sahasā pavassi, so temayī tassa karīsamaggaṃ.
segments.ja490:10.1: Tato ahaṃ nikkhamisaṃ bhadante, cando yathā rāhumukhā pamutto;
segments.ja490:10.3: Tasmā ahaṃposathaṃ pālayāmi, lobho mamaṃ mā punarāgamāsi.
segments.ja490:11.1: Vammīkathūpasmiṃ kipillikāni, nippothayanto tuvaṃ pure carāsi;
segments.ja490:11.3: Khudaṃ pipāsaṃ adhivāsayanto, kasmā bhavaṃposathiko nu accha [accho (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja490:12.1: Sakaṃ niketaṃ atihīḷayāno [atiheḷayāno (syā. ka.)], atricchatā [atricchatāya (sī. syā. pī.)] mallagāmaṃ [malataṃ (sī. pī.), mallayataṃ (ka.)] agacchiṃ;
segments.ja490:12.3: Tato janā nikkhamitvāna gāmā, kodaṇḍakena paripothayiṃsu maṃ.
segments.ja490:13.1: So bhinnasīso ruhiramakkhitaṅgo, paccāgamāsiṃ sakaṃ [sa sakaṃ (syā. ka.),’ tha sakaṃ (?)] niketaṃ;
segments.ja490:13.3: Tasmā ahaṃposathaṃ pālayāmi, atricchatā mā punarāgamāsi.
segments.ja490:14.1: Yaṃ no apucchittha tuvaṃ bhadante, sabbeva byākarimha yathā pajānaṃ;
segments.ja490:14.3: Mayampi pucchāma tuvaṃ bhadante, kasmā bhavaṃposathiko nu brahme.
segments.ja490:15.1: Anūpalitto mama assamamhi, paccekabuddho muhuttaṃ nisīdi;
segments.ja490:15.3: So maṃ avedī gatimāgatiñca, nāmañca gottaṃ caraṇañca sabbaṃ.
segments.ja490:16.1: Evampahaṃ vandi na [evampahaṃ naggahe (sī. pī.)] tassa pāde, na cāpi naṃ mānagatena pucchiṃ;
segments.ja490:16.3: Tasmā ahaṃposathaṃ pālayāmi, māno mamaṃ mā punarāgamāsīti.
